# load

Load CSV data into a Dataverse entity

## Usage

```
ppds data load [options]
```

## Options

| Long | Short | Type | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `--analyze` |  | `bool` |  | Analyze mapping without loading data (preview which columns match) |
| `--batch-size` |  | `int` |  | Records per batch (default: 100) |
| `--bypass-flows` |  | `bool` |  | Bypass Power Automate flow triggers |
| `--bypass-plugins` |  | `string` |  | Bypass custom plugin execution: sync, async, or all (requires prvBypassCustomBusinessLogic privilege) |
| `--continue-on-error` |  | `bool` |  | Continue loading on individual record failures |
| `--debug` |  | `bool` |  | Enable diagnostic logging output |
| `--dry-run` |  | `bool` |  | Validate without writing to Dataverse |
| `--entity` | `-e` | `string` |  | Target entity logical name |
| `--environment` | `-env` | `string` |  | Override the environment URL. Takes precedence over profile's bound environment. |
| `--file` | `-f` | `FileInfo` |  | Path to CSV file |
| `--force` |  | `bool` |  | Force loading even when auto-mapping is incomplete (unmatched columns will be skipped) |
| `--generate-mapping` |  | `FileInfo` |  | Generate mapping template to specified file |
| `--key` | `-k` | `string` |  | Alternate key field(s) for upsert. Comma-separated for composite keys. |
| `--mapping` | `-m` | `FileInfo` |  | Path to column mapping JSON file |
| `--output-format` | `-o` | `OutputFormat` |  | Output format |
| `--profile` | `-p` | `string` |  | Profile name(s). For high-throughput pooling, specify multiple Application User profiles comma-separated (e.g., app1,app2,app3) - each profile multiplies API quota. |
| `--verbose` | `-v` | `bool` |  | Enable verbose logging output |
